instruction: Choose a suitable engineering drawing/CAD application available in the current Ubuntu environment. The task is to edit a DXF drawing, so select software that can reliably open, modify, and export DXF files. Open or import /home/user/Desktop/gui18_wall_openings_seed.dxf. Create a 900 mm wide door opening in the wall with opening center x=1200. Create a 1200 mm wide window opening with opening center x=3300. At the door opening, add a door leaf line and a door swing arc. At the window opening, add two window lines on layer WINDOW. Keep the remaining wall segments on layer WALL. Save as /home/user/Desktop/gui18_wall_openings_completed.dxf. Complete the work through an interactive graphical workflow and save/export the required DXF file to the exact Desktop path stated above. Do not generate the drawing with external scripts, command-line CAD generation, or by directly writing DXF entities programmatically.
